meaning.en: Any of various extinct primates considered to be close relatives or ancestors of modern humans and having some characteristics of nonhuman apes. Not in scientific use.

meaning.en: Any of several extinct primates, as a pithecanthropine, with structural characteristics intermediate between ape and man.
